text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The first half of February, huh. Okay.

Acute! What holiday does this time of
year make
you think of?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Why, it makes me think of Valentine's
Day.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Valentine's Day?! Not Setsubun?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Setsubun's a way bigger deal, isn't it?
You scatter
the beans and then
everyone has inari sushi
together!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's the talk of the town right
now,
though. I keep hearing everyone
ask each other
who they're going to give
their chocolates to.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see... I must've overlooked it.
Valentine's Day,
huh? The day you give
chocolate to someone
special...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it's February's main event, I'd
better get
ready.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
According to feng shui, you have to use

handmade chocolate to really grab hold
of
someone's heart. Which means...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna do it! Acute, help me
out here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When you're trying to win someone's
heart, what
do you think is most
important?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Being heartfelt?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Close! That's definitely important, but I think the answer is using feng shui to maximize how sincere your feelings are! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Since ancient times, chocolate has been
known to
have a calming effect.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So if I get them nice and relaxed and I use feng shui to boost my heartfelt feelings... they'll crumble, easy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if I set off in an
auspicious
direction to buy the
ingredients, then use pink
chocolate
icing...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I should be able to capture Trainer's
heart! This
Valentine's Day, the feng shui
is going to be off
the charts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna make the ultimate happy chocolate! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ultimate, hmm? Sounds like it'll pack
quite the
punch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the fourteenth of February. After
filling in
some racing documents, I set
off to submit them,
when...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer! I've got something
nice for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey and Wonder Acute
appear in
front of me. Given the date,
could this be...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: It certainly is! I helped out myself, and the results were very scrumptious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Go on then, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Okay! Um... Um... Um!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's some inari sushi! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She abruptly hands me a platter of inari
sushi.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yep! They say that when you eat inari
sushi after
Setsubun, you'll feel
overcome with happiness.
choice_data_list: いなり寿司！？しかもセット？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: So eat up! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rickey? What happened to the
chocolate we
made together?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Shh, shh! You don't have to bring that
up, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Did something happen? Did it melt,
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nope, nope. It didn't melt or anything.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When I really thought about it, I felt too
embarrassed to
give Trainer chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I figured maybe it could wait, at least
until my luck
improves a little more.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Bye, Trainer! Make sure you eat all that
inari
sushi. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna go have some tea... to go
with our
chocolate. See ya! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I'm suddenly left with an inari sushi platter. In all fairness though, it is good.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... Morning, Trainer. It's finally... fiiinally done.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here... Try this. It'll make a monumental

difference to your feng shui power. Your
world
will never be the same again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's eyes are unusually
serious. Not
to mention, today is
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle, rustle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I open the present to find just what I
suspected:
some handmade chocolate. I
take a bite, and...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? You're starting to
get this
strange feeling in your chest,
right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Like you're getting in the mood to work
really
hard for me? And devote your
whole life to me?
That kinda mood?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Like your heart's turned a
Rickey-kinda
color?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yay! Then it was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's truly a feng shui Valentine's Day! ♪
No wall
around your heart is too tough
for me to break
through!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But actually...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean, even before you ate
the
chocolate?
choice_data_list: ずっと、そういう気持ちだけどな
ずっと、そういう気持ちだけどね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I'm saying anything
extraordinary.
Being a trainer is all about
putting your racer's
future first.
choice_data_list: ああ、リッキー第一でやってきたから
うん、リッキー第一でやってきたし

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh. I see. So I guess the chocolate had
nothing to
do with it... No, more
importantly—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You can't just say I'm your number one
so casually
like that! Especially when you
don't usually say
that kinda stuff!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I mean, I gave you the chocolate, but now you've got me blushing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey seems very flustered all
of a
sudden.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. I guess you win, today. I can't
believe the
chocolate didn't work. Still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next time, my feng shui will prove
victorious! The
chocolate I'm gonna
make will blow your socks
off!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You better brace yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day helps us realize that we
don't
even need to rely on feng
shui—our feelings are
already in sync.
